title: Typst Bindings for R
text: fonts: pass font_path load font files directory compiling. pdf standard: pass pdf_standard request Typst PDF profile "1.7", "2.0", "-2b", "ua-1". ua-1, document needs title. Unsupported invalid standards raise error. output format: pass output_format export "pdf", "html", "png", "svg". omit , tynding infer format output extension possible otherwise default PDF. Multi-page png svg exports multiple pages create multiple files. order behaves Typst CLI, ’ll need pass output file name template string. example: create output-1.png output-2.png. root: default, root path corresponds parent directory file (detected automatically), can use root argument specify different path, often useful complex projects , example, font files located parent directory. let organize project follow, isn’t possible default: Learn documentation website.
code: library(tynding)  markup <- c(   '#set document(title: "custom font example")',   '#set text(font: "Ultra")',   '= hello world' )  typ_file <- typst_write(markup) pdf_file <- typst_compile(typ_file, font_path = "path/to/fonts") markup <- c(   '#set document(title: "accessible PDF")',   "= hello world" )  typ_file <- typst_write(markup) pdf_file <- typst_compile(typ_file, pdf_standard = "ua-1") library(tynding)  markup <- c(   '#set document(title: "hello from tynding")',   "= hello world",   "this document was compiled from R." )  typ_file <- typst_write(markup) png_file <- typst_compile(typ_file, output_format = "png") library(tynding)  markup <- c(   "this document was compiled from R.",   "#pagebreak()" )  typ_file <- typst_write(markup) png_file <- typst_compile(typ_file, output_format = "png", output = "output-{p}.png") library(tynding)  typst_compile(   "reports/typst/document.typ",   root = "reports",   font_path = "reports/fonts" ) root/ ├── typst/ │   └── document.typ └── fonts/     ├── MyFont.tff     └── MyFont-Bold.tff

text: can send inputs thanks Typst sys inputs handling. Basically, things R, send whatever want Typst! example: file.typ looks like :  extra arguments accepted. Scalar values passed -; values JSON-encoded (using jsonlite::toJSON()) means can, instance, send dataframe R create Typst table. Typst file looks like:
code: library(tynding)  typst_compile(   "file.typ",   title = "Quarterly report",   # all additional arguments...   author = "Joseph",   persons = list(     list(name = "Joseph", age = 25),     list(name = "Justine", age = 24),     list(name = "Isaac", age = 2)   ) ) #set page(width: 10cm, height: 4cm, fill: rgb("#fca311"))  #let title = sys.inputs.at("title") #let author = sys.inputs.at("author") #let persons = json(sys.inputs.at("persons"))  = #title *Author:* #author  #for person in persons [   #strong(person.name) is #text(fill: red.darken(50%), weight: "bold", [#person.age]) years old. \ ] df <- data.frame(   field = c("TQ8345", "TQ8345", "TQ8445"),   treated_area = c(4.47, 5.52, 6.34),   water = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE) )  typst_compile(   "file.typ",   data = df ) #set page(width: 10cm, height: 15cm, fill: rgb("#faedcd"))  #let data = json(sys.inputs.at("data")) #let keys = data.at(0).keys() #let cols = (1fr,) + range(1, keys.len()).map(_ => 1fr)  #table(   columns: cols,   table.header(..keys.map(key=>[#text(weight: "bold", key)])),   ..data   .map(row => keys.map(key => [#row.at(key, default: "n/a")]))   .flatten(), )

title: Compile a .typ file and return the output path. — typst_compile
text: file Path existing .typ file. output Optional output path. Defaults input path extension implied output format. font_path Optional path font files. pdf_standard Optional PDF standard specification. Options : : 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 1.7, 2.0, -1b, -1a, -2b, -2u, -2a, -3b, -3u, -3a, -4, -4f, -4e, ua-1. used PDF output. output_format Optional output format. Supported values pdf, html, png, svg. Defaults NULL, means "infer output possible, otherwise use pdf". multi-page png svg outputs, output must template path containing least one {p}, {0p}, {t}. root Optional Typst project root. Defaults parent directory file. provided, file must contained directory's subtree. ppi Optional pixels per inch value exporting png. NULL, default 144.0. ... Named inputs passed Typst document via sys.inputs. argument must named. Scalar values passed -; values JSON-encoded.
